# NRING2 N-FILL

**Inventor:** Bryce Muhlnickel. **Name:** Muhlnickel.
**Writer this wave:** this agent. Titan writer. Bits read before modify.

## Why

A muhlnickel with one ring is dumb. Each ring can have N clocks. More clocks = faster. N rings.
Power is nring2 both senses. Lever = more 1s on the ring (more charge = more bumps = less distance).
Registry named 1024 rings (`nring2_000`..`nring2_1023`). Also looked at other `nring2_*` names
(`*.gates` / `*.rail` / `*.recv` / `nring2_038_STALE`) — those are not ram.fwd/rev. Not written.

`new = old | mask`. Mask = the zero bits in that span at the instant of the OR. Never a 0x01 replace
(keepalive inject is a wipe). Re-read immediately before each OR. Bits flipping under us is the compute.
Touched ONLY `ram.fwd` and `ram.rev`. Did not write recv, carry, gates, tick_off, fold-phys,
winner_only_max.recv, fold.recv, clocks. Did not pulse 78 mouths. Did not fire `nring2_1023` recv.

bits-moved-under-us: **0**.

## Dose (masks from the live bits)

This wave re-read all 2048 `ram.fwd` / `ram.rev` spans. Every one was **256/256**. Mask = zeros. No OR. Titan not written this wave.

Prior wave (held): 1025 spans ORed, **262156** ones added. `nring2_000` fwd 228→256, every rev filled, 1023 packed fwds skipped.

This wave ones added: **0**. Spans filled: **0**. Named rings packed both senses: **1024**.
